Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence

About the Job

The Deployment Infrastructure team is hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and evolution of the web UI for our build and deployment platform. In this role, you’ll craft a cohesive, intuitive user experience that enables engineers across Reddit to build, test, and ship software safely and confidently to a globally distributed cloud ecosystem.

Our team owns continuous integration, continuous deployment, and the underlying systems that power build and deployment workflows. We’re looking for an engineer who operates at the intersection of frontend engineering, distributed systems and infrastructure, and developer experience.

In your day-to-day, you can expect to:

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality features across the stack, with a focus on creating reusable, maintainable UI components and polished frontends that scale with the platform
  • Contribute to backend systems to deliver cohesive, end-to-end product experiences
  • Define and enforce clean API boundaries between frontend and backend systems
  • Collaborate with teammates to build a platform that supports:
    • Orchestrating complex deployment workflows
    • Progressive rollouts across clusters and regions
    • Automated rollback of failed deployments
    • Observability into deployment health and performance

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

Marketing at Intapp is organized around vertical go-to-market motions — and the financial services segment is one of the most complex and competitive. The Campaign Manager, Financial Services sits at the center of that effort, owning the full campaign lifecycle for a vertical that spans private equity, investment banking, capital markets, and alternative asset management. Reporting to the Global Paid Media and Financial Services GTM Programs Director, this role has direct influence on how Intapp shows up with buyers and how marketing moves pipeline.

Day to day, this means translating business priorities and active sales plays into integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns — managing briefs, audience targeting, timelines, asset development, and performance reporting across a wide set of stakeholders. You'll work closely with PMM, creative, marketing operations, field marketing, and editorial to keep programs on strategy and on schedule, and you'll be the person who turns campaign data into clear signals for the sales team and senior leadership. Experience with B2B campaign operations, marketing automation platforms, project management tools, and financial services industry contexts will all be relevant here.

What You Will Do:

As a Campaign Manager, Financial Services, you can expect to:

  • Design and execute integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns across the financial services verticals, managing timelines, briefs, and launch plans from kickoff through measurement.
  • Own audience deployment in partnership with Marketing Operations — requesting and validating lists, segment filters, suppression logic, and play-based targeting to protect the buyer journey and cover gaps in target account coverage.
  • Lead cross-functional working teams across PMM, creative, partner marketing, client marketing, editorial, and channel owners to drive campaign execution from brief to launch.
  • Build and maintain a full-year integrated marketing plan that spans campaign sequencing, content milestones, paid activations, and event overlaps across all marketing functions.
  • Report campaign performance to senior stakeholders and sales leadership through regular readout meetings, QBRs, and steering committee presentations, translating data into pipeline impact and actionable recommendations.
  • Track deliverables, dependencies, and readiness in Asanawith cross-functional teamstomonitorrisks, delays, and approvals.

What You Will Need:

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team.

  • Demonstrated experience in demand generation, campaign operations, or lifecycle marketing in a B2B environment, with a track record of executing programs that move pipeline
  • Strong cross-functional project leadership skills — comfortable managing multiple simultaneous workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders across a matrixed organization
  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and campaign management platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Demandbase, or Pardot
  • An analytical mindset — able to diagnose funnel bottlenecks, interpret performance data, and translate insights into campaign adjustments
  • GTM and messaging fluency — able to connect campaign strategy to business objectives and engage credibly with field sales, PMM, and senior leadership

What You Will Gain at Intapp:

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Expand Your Skills:Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

About Zuma

Zuma is pioneering the future of agentic AI and our focus is to transform the rental market experience for consumers and property manager alike. Our innovative platform is engineered from the ground up to boost operations efficiency and enhance support capabilities for property management business across the US and Canada, a ~$200B market.
Off the back of our Series-A in early 2024, Zuma is scaling rapidly. Achieving our vision requires a team of passionate, innovative individuals eager to leverage technology to redefine customer-business interactions. We're on the hunt for exceptional talent ready to join our mission and contribute to building a groundbreaking technology that reshapes how businesses engage with customers.
Zuma has raised over $17M in funding to date and has support from world-renowned investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, King River, Range Ventures, and distinguished angel investors like YC’s former COO, Qasar Younis.

The Role

As a Support Engineer at Zuma, you’ll be a bridge between our customers, engineering team, and product vision. You’ll ensure new customers onboard smoothly, integrations run reliably, and support operations scale as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves problem-solving, can dive into APIs and databases, and takes pride in clear documentation and communication. You’ll help property managers succeed with our AI platform while also driving continuous improvements in our internal tools and processes.

Why This Could Be Your Dream Role

  • You want to work at a company where customers feel your impact every day
  • You'll have autonomy to design and implement innovative technical solutions
  • Your work will directly impact thousands of apartment communities and millions of renters
  • You'll receive significant equity in a venture-backed company with strong traction
  • As we scale, your role and influence will grow with the company

Why You Might Want to Think Twice

  • This is a demanding role that will often require extended hours and deep commitment
  • As a founding team member, you'll need to wear multiple hats and step outside your comfort zone
  • You'll need to make thoughtful tradeoffs between innovation and immediate needs
  • You'll interact directly with customers to understand their needs and occasionally travel to their offices
  • We're a startup - priorities can shift rapidly as we respond to market opportunities and customer needs
  • If you're not comfortable getting your hands dirty with legacy code or speaking directly with customers, this isn't the job for you

Responsibilities

  • Lead critical system rewrites to transform our architecture into a highly scalable, resilient foundation
  • Own the design and performance optimization of our data storage systems, ensuring they scale with customer and AI demands
  • Build and evolve our deployment pipelines, enabling reliable, automated releases for AI-first products
  • Set up and manage modern cloud infrastructure from scratch, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure consistency, security, and scalability
  • Establish engineering best practices, including observability, incident response processes, and system hardening for an AI-first platform
  • Drive robust analytics and monitoring to track performance, reliability, and the effectiveness of our AI solutions
  • Mentor engineers and elevate the team's capabilities across infrastructure, scalability, and AI product development

Your Experience Looks Like

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade software systems, with a focus on scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Proven expertise in backend development with , including API design, system architecture, and cloud-based services
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and deploying production systems using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi)
  • Hands-on experience with database design, performance tuning, and scaling high-throughput data systems
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a distributed, fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, high-ownership environments with evolving requirements
  • Bonus: Experience with React and TypeScript on the frontend, though this role leans backend/infrastructure
  • Bonus: Exposure to LLM-based systems, AI infrastructure, or agentic AI workflows

Guiding Principles

    Customer‑First Outcomes

    Every commit should trace back to resident or operator value. Whether it’s a new feature, infra investment, or AI capability, if it doesn’t solve a real problem, it doesn’t ship.

    Bias for Simplicity

    We favor composable primitives over clever abstractions. Open standards, clean APIs, and clear contracts win over custom complexity, even if the custom version is cooler.

    Quality Is a Gate, Not an After‑Thought

    Quality is built-in from day one. Our definition of done includes: test coverage, performance checks, basic observability, and internal docs. Shipping fast doesn’t mean skipping craftsmanship.

    Data‑Driven Choices

    We use data to guide, not paralyze, our decision-making. We track leading indicators (cycle time, defect rate, NPS) and lagging signals (retention, revenue impact). We keep instrumentation lightweight but meaningful signal over spreadsheet.

    Transparency & Written Culture

    Good ideas don’t expire in Zoom. We operate in public inside the company, TDDs, PR reviews, and Linear tickets tell the story. This keeps us async-friendly, auditable, and aligned across time zones and functions.

Other Benefits

  • Great health insurance, dental, and vision.
  • Gym and workspace stipends.
  • Computer and workspace enhancements.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Opportunity to play a critical role in building the foundations of the company and Engineering culture.

Operations Technical Lead

Would you like to drive innovation at the intersection of content, technology, and AI by improving workflows and solving complex data challenges?

Are you keen to join a Global Leader in Legal Analytics and Technology?

About our Team

At LexisNexis, we’re more than a legal and professional services company — we’re a team of thinkers, doers, and problem solvers. With 11,800 colleagues in over 150 countries, we’re using cutting-edge technology, including AI, to power real change in the legal and compliance industries.

About the role

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex content and data challenges while ensuring the delivery of high-quality legal information to customers. You will partner with Editorial, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to manage content conversion, troubleshoot data and workflow issues, lead user acceptance testing, and drive continuous quality improvements across digital and print platforms. As part of LexisNexis Legal's modernization journey, you will also contribute to automation and AI-enabled initiatives that enhance content operations, scalability, and customer experience.

Responsibilities

Content Operations & Conversion

  • Build and maintain new and replacement content sources across multiple content types.
  • Perform end-to-end conversion troubleshooting, ensuring accurate transformation from source input to customer-ready content across digital and print formats.
  • Analyze input data (XML, HTML, Word, InDesign, PDF) to ensure proper conversion handling, metadata accuracy, and compliance with conversion specifications.
  • Resolve XML markup and structural issues across multiple content types, ensuring consistency across digital and print outputs.
  • Ensure outputs align with product requirements and downstream platform behavior.

User Acceptance Testing & Quality

  • Create and execute UAT plans and test cases for new features, product launches, and workflow changes.
  • Validate functional and non-functional requirements across content and platform workflows.
  • Track and manage defects in tools such as Azure DevOps, partnering with Engineering, QA, Product, and vendors to triage, prioritize, and validate fixes.
  • Maintain and continuously improve QA checklists, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Help reduce defect escape rates through proactive validation and quality controls.

Data Flow Monitoring & Issue Resolution

  • Monitor content data pipelines from editorial through conversion to delivery of customer-ready content across digital and print formats.
  • Diagnose and remediate data, conversion, and integration issues across systems.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Editorial, Product, Engineering, and offshore partners to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Address customer-facing concerns by prioritizing, investigating, and resolving issues.

Tooling, Automation & Modernization

  • Identify and support opportunities for automation and AI-enabled workflow improvements.
  • Contribute to modernization and migration initiatives by evaluating impact, dependencies, and risks.
  • Support improvements to conversion frameworks, blueprints, and workflows to increase efficiency.

Documentation, Standards & Collaboration

  • Maintain documentation, standards, and governance
  • Communicate issues, risks, decisions, and impacts clearly
  • Partner with Editorial, Product, Engineering, IT, vendors, and offshore teams to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum

Requirements

  • 2 to 3 years of experience content operations, digital publishing, technical operations, project management or related field
  • Hands-on experience with XML, XSD, and markup troubleshooting; familiarity with XSLT/XPath.
  • Experience monitoring content data flows and resolving production issues.
  • Strong systems thinking and troubleshooting skills.
  • High attention to detail and quality mindset.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
  • Experience in automation and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure Dev Ops or Jira is a plus.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Medical Inpatient and Outpatient Insurance: Coverage for your healthcare needs.
  • Long Service Award: Recognition for your dedication and loyalty.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

raw.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


About the Role

Beckett is the trusted authority in sports card and collectibles grading, pricing, and marketplace services. Our platform is mid-transformation: a new generation of NestJS/TypeScript microservices and Next.js frontends is actively replacing a prior generation of Java/Spring Boot services, while two large legacy PHP monoliths still power critical grading and e-commerce workflows. Getting this migration right — without disrupting the business — is the defining technical challenge of the next few years.

As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. You have expertise in the entirety of your team's products and services — how they interact and how data flows between them — and you're building the same understanding of adjacent systems. You lead projects of moderate-to-significant scope over one-to-two-quarter horizons, design for the platform's future rather than just the next feature, and are recognized by peers and leaders as an authority in your domain.

What You'll Do

Set technical direction

  • Own the architecture of your team's domain end to end: services, data flows, integration points, and failure modes across the full portfolio (e.g., NestJS services, their Postgres/MySQL data stores, the legacy systems they front, and the frontends they serve).

  • Design products and services that allow for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling, deliberately reducing the friction of future changes — service boundaries, contract design, data ownership, and migration paths.

  • Lead high-stakes modernization work: defining strangler patterns around the PHP monolith, sequencing Java→TypeScript service replacements, and ensuring byte-compatible, low-risk cutovers.

  • Build a working understanding of adjacent systems and products across the org — grading, marketplace, CRM, payments, identity, data/ETL — and use it to catch cross-system risks early.

  • Set the bar for security, testing, observability, and operational excellence, and use operational data to drive stability and performance improvements.

  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the tech org: establish standards and guardrails for AI coding tools (code review expectations, testing requirements, security and IP hygiene), identify where AI agents can accelerate the modernization effort (legacy code comprehension, test generation, migration scaffolding), and measure the impact.

Lead Delivery

  • Successfully lead projects of moderate scope and/or complexity spanning 1–2 quarters, coordinating engineers, stakeholders, and dependencies to a predictable landing.

  • Plan and develop using an explicit value-vs-cost framework, so urgency and prioritization are easily understood by both the team and stakeholders.

  • Identify and communicate blockers and delays within your team to the right stakeholders before they become surprises.

Multiply the Organization

  • Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and documentation within your team and with business stakeholders — initiate and facilitate meaningful discussions around complex issues.

  • Build strong relationships with teammates, your manager, business stakeholders, and senior engineers across the organization.

  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback; foster a culture where feedback is sought out and used as a tool for growth.

  • Raise the org's collective AI fluency: share proven workflows, prompts, and agent configurations; coach engineers on when AI tooling helps and when it misleads; and keep the team current as the tooling landscape evolves.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership of multi-engineer, multi-quarter projects.

  • Expert-level backend engineering in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Java, with the range to be effective across our polyglot estate (TypeScript, Java 21, PHP, Python, C#).

  • Full-stack range: hands-on production experience across the entire stack — modern React/Next.js frontends, API and service layers, relational data stores, and the infrastructure they run on — with the judgment to design and review at every layer, even where others do the bulk of the implementation.

  • Proven experience modernizing legacy systems: strangler-fig migrations, service extraction from monoliths, or platform re-architecture under live traffic.

  • Deep relational database expertise (PostgreSQL, MySQL): data modeling, migrations, performance, and the realities of shared-database coupling between services.

  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: service boundaries, API/contract design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), messaging (SQS), idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Production AWS depth — ECS, Lambda, networking, IAM — and infrastructure-as-code fluency (AWS CDK and/or Terraform).

  • A track record of raising engineering standards: testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident response.

  • Strong, hands-on background in AI tooling and usage: daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI-generated code.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences alike.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontend architecture at scale (design systems, micro-frontends, performance budgets) or mobile (React Native/Expo).

  • Experience with e-commerce, marketplace, payments, or high-traffic consumer platforms.

  • Data platform exposure (Snowflake, ETL pipelines, dimensional modeling) or applied ML (computer vision).

  • Experience building LLM-powered features or platforms: LLM API integration (Anthropic/OpenAI), retrieval-augmented generation, evals, or agent frameworks (e.g., MCP) — and shipping them to production responsibly.

  • Interest in sports cards, gaming, or collectibles!

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and build the adaptor layer between AI service engines and the enterprise service bus, including construction and handling of FHIR PAS (Prior Authorization Support) payloads.
  • Build a new synchronous service engine for real-time AI workloads (e.g., letter generation), adapting the architecture of the existing asynchronous Triage engine.
  • Build, deploy, and operate LLM-based agents on the service engines; own the mechanics of getting an agent from configuration to production.
  • Support and maintain the existing production Triage services: bug fixes, dependency and model upgrades, releases, and operational health.
  • Integrate LLM and generative AI services (Azure OpenAI and related) into production business workflows.
  • Implement CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and observability for AI services; contribute to dashboards and alerting.
  • Work within the team's architecture standards and review gates; document what you build so others can run it.
  • Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong Python; experience with at least one other modern language (TypeScript, C#, Java, or Go).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices, including message-driven / service-bus integration patterns.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic) into applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments with code review, testing, and CI/CD.

Preferred Requirements

  • FHIR experience — especially prior-authorization workflows (PAS implementation guide, X12 278 crosswalk) or other healthcare interoperability (HL7v2, CDA).
  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks and patterns (e.g., pydantic-ai, LangGraph, or similar) and structured-output LLM development.
  • Experience with LLM observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry-based tracing; Logfire or similar).
  • Azure cloud experience (Azure AI services, Azure SQL, containerized deployment).
  • Docker/Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Healthcare, payer, or other regulated-domain engineering experience.

Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr. Digital Product Manager, Forecasting

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the strategy, discovery, development, and adoption of high-impact digital products that improve how Amgen forecasts, plans, evaluates scenarios, and makes complex business decisions. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology to translate sophisticated analytical capabilities into intuitive, trusted, and scalable products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Translate Amgen’s digital strategy into product visions, roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer decisions, workflows, assumptions, and planning challenges across Commercial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and R&D.
  • Frame complex and ambiguous business problems as product opportunities, identifying where forecasting, optimization, simulation, scenario planning, automation, or AI-enabled decision support can improve outcomes.
  • Partner with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, architects, and designers to translate analytical methods and models into scalable and usable digital products.
  • Ensure forecasting and decision-support products make assumptions, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and model outputs understandable and actionable, with appropriate monitoring of model performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Influence senior stakeholders, reconcile competing priorities, and align cross-functional teams around a shared product vision, roadmap, and measures of success.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic capabilities, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation while supporting responsible AI, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Establish effective operating rhythms, decision rights, documentation, and communication practices for globally distributed teams.
  • Drive product adoption and value realization by measuring impact on business performance, efficiency, decision-making, and user experience.
  • Mentor product managers and contribute to an outcome-oriented product culture across Amgen.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Master’s degree and 6 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of Digital Product Management experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Digital Product Management experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years’ experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Product Management and Product Mindset
    • Proven digital product leader with experience connecting business strategy, customer needs, data and analytics, and technology.
    • Experience leading data-intensive, analytical, or decision-support products from discovery through launch, adoption, and scaling.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate complex decisions, planning processes, and analytical methods into compelling product strategies and intuitive customer experiences.
    • Strong customer-first and outcome-oriented mindset, balancing user needs, business value, data, and technical feasibility.
    • Experience applying Agile methods to multidisciplinary product, data science, and engineering teams.
    • Strong understanding of technology ecosystems, enterprise data platforms, and digital architecture principles.
  • Forecasting, Planning, and Decision Science
    • Experience developing products that incorporate forecasting, predictive analytics, optimization, simulation, scenario planning, machine learning, or other advanced analytical capabilities.
    • Ability to partner effectively with data scientists and technical teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate model outputs, uncertainty, and limitations to nontechnical stakeholders.
    • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, or another complex planning environment is preferred.
  • Leadership and Interpersonal
    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional product teams and drive execution without relying solely on formal authority.
    • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities, and create alignment in ambiguous environments.
    • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, including translating complex analytical and technical topics into clear business narratives.
    • Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Overview

Change Business Partner - MRP

Location: South Korea remote

Employment: 12 month fixed term contract

Role Overview:

The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations. This includes driving the adoption of new systems, processes, and behaviours that enhance efficiency, safety, and growth. A key focus of the role is enabling robust implementation and sustainable adoption of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) processes within the ERP environment (notably Microsoft D365), ensuring supply chain accuracy, production efficiency, and inventory optimisation. The role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing, ERP, and change facilitation to support both people and site-level transitions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Business Unit leaders, site managers, and functional teams, aligning change initiatives with manufacturing and business priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Highlander team in simplifying points of contact, improving clarity on local priorities and explaining core model deployment
  • Lead and support change management efforts related to process improvements and the ERP implementations, notably for MRP and sales & operational planning
  • Conduct business impact assessments, readiness analyses, and stakeholder mapping across production sites, sales offices and central functions.
  • Assess training needs and coordinate training delivery
  • Develop and execute communication and engagement plans to ensure smooth transitions with minimal disruption to operations.
  • Identify resistance and risks to adoption across various business units and develop practical strategies to address them.
  • Collaborate with local operational teams to coordinate integrated change activities.
  • Promote continuous improvement culture by embedding new behaviours, tools, and mindsets at all levels of the organization.
  • Track and report business change readiness, identifying gaps and proposing mitigating actions.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Deep understanding of shop floor processes, operations, production workflows, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Hands-on experience in supporting or deploying MRP modules in ERP systems (Microsoft D365 or similar), with a track record of driving adoption and performance improvement.
  • Ability to bridge the gap between IT system design and operational execution for MRP and related planning functions.
  • Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.
  • Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics, especially MRP, P2P and Forecast to stock processes as well as margin management.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence frontline teams, middle management, and senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence frameworks would be an advantage.
  • Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, Microsoft D365) is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working at different levels of the organisation.
  • Flexible to adapt to the changing business needs of the projects.
  • Serves as best practice/quality resource within MRP and ERP Transformations.

Qualifications and Behaviours:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Aptitude to learn and adapt, seeing change opportunities and encouraging others to seek positive change.
  • Change Management or Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in change, transformation, or multi-site operational roles within manufacturing or industrial sectors.

Morgan Advanced Materials is an EEO/AA/M/W/D/V Employer Ind-1

Morgan Advanced Materials is a business rich in history and innovation. Founded in the UK in 1856, we have grown into a global organisation with 70 sites in 18 countries. Our model to serve our customers where they need us has led to a diversified product range using our unparalleled expertise in ceramic and carbon materials, which we exploit to solve difficult problems for our customers across a diverse range of markets.

We are a purpose driven organisation. Our purpose is to use advanced materials to make the world more sustainable and to improve the quality of life. We deliver on that purpose through the products that we make, and the way that we make them.

We help our customers push the limits of their processes and products to meet the demanding requirements they face, from higher process temperatures to higher product performance to increasing miniaturisation.

Key Figures: Revenue £1,114.7m (2023), ~8,500 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

Job Requisition ID: 94508

Location Designation: Fully Remote

Senior Associate Underwriter

Fully Remote with occasional travel - Our typical travel is about 4 days 2 times per year.

Role Overview

Reporting to a Managing Underwriter, the Senior Associate Underwriter is responsible for evaluating life insurance applications and determining whether applications should be approved, declined, or if additional information is required. This role is accountable for underwriting higher-complexity cases with a 2-Year Total Amount at Risk (TAAR) of up to $5 million and routinely handles applications that include Attending Physician Statements and multiple or complex impairments.

The Senior Associate Underwriter applies advanced underwriting expertise, medical knowledge, and sound judgment to assess overall mortality risk and make informed decisions on complex cases. This role serves as a resource to less experienced underwriters, provides guidance on difficult case scenarios, and works closely with agents, General Office personnel, and internal partners to support timely, accurate underwriting decisions while delivering a strong customer experience. The position also plays a key role in underwriting projects, process improvements, and training initiatives, contributing to continuous improvement and modernization efforts.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate life insurance applications and accurately classify mortality risk using medical and nonmedical information for cases with a 2-Year TAAR of up to $5 million, including cases involving Attending Physician Statements and complex medical histories.
  • Apply advanced underwriting guidelines, clinical knowledge, and professional judgment to assess complex and nuanced risk factors and determine appropriate underwriting outcomes, including standard and substandard offers, exclusions, or declines.
  • Independently manage a portfolio of higher-complexity cases, prioritizing workload to meet service and quality expectations.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for peers by providing guidance on case consultation, interpretation of medical impairments, and application of underwriting guidelines.
  • Communicate underwriting requirements, application updates, reinsurance considerations, reconsideration requests, and final decisions to agents and General Office personnel through both written and verbal interactions with a high degree of professionalism and clarity.
  • Collaborate with reinsurers on complex cases and effectively evaluate and incorporate facultative offers into final underwriting decisions.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of underwriting systems, product rules, medical advances, and mortality trends to support accurate and consistent decision-making.
  • Contribute to training initiatives, mentorship of junior underwriters, workflow enhancements, best practice discussions, and cross-functional projects that improve underwriting processes, consistency, and customer experience.
  • Support adoption and effective use of underwriting models, rules engines, and emerging tools by applying judgment and ensuring alignment with guidelines and risk philosophy.

What You'll Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of life underwriting experience with demonstrated expertise in underwriting principles and mortality assessment, including complex case handling.
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology and the ability to evaluate the impact of multiple and interacting impairments on mortality risk.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex risk profiles and make sound, independent underwriting decisions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate decisions and influence stakeholders, including agents and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume workload of complex cases while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and service standards.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to manage relationships and deliver timely, professional support in more complex scenarios.

Preferred Skills

  • Significant experience underwriting complex cases involving Attending Physician Statements, multiple impairments, and higher face amounts.
  • Experience working with reinsurance partners and evaluating facultative offers on complex cases.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, or provide guidance to less experienced underwriters.
  • Experience participating in or leading workflow improvement initiatives, training efforts, or cross-functional projects.
  • Ability to balance risk assessment, operational efficiency, and customer experience expectations in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of underwriting models, rules engines, and automated decision tools, with the ability to interpret outputs, apply appropriate judgment, and ensure decisions align with underwriting guidelines and philosophy.
  • Familiarity with broader technology tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, and underwriting automation tools) that enhance efficiency, decision support, and workflow effectiveness.
  • Comfort operating in a more data- and AI-enabled underwriting environment, including supporting explainability and transparency of model-driven outputs to internal and external stakeholders.

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Overview

The Principal Technology Architect helps define the future of our SaaS product architecture by combining strategic technology vision with hands-on design across cloud infrastructure, enterprise DevOps workflows, and next-generation agentic AI capabilities. This role is ideal for a senior architect who can set architectural direction while actively shaping secure, scalable, and resilient solutions using AWS, AI-enabled engineering practices, and emerging agent technologies.

In this senior individual contributor role, you will translate complex business and technology needs into practical architecture roadmaps and executable designs. You will lead architecture decisions for cloud-native platforms, DevOps automation, agentic AI integration, orchestration patterns, agent-to-agent collaboration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AWS capabilities such as AgentCore, Strands, and Amazon Bedrock.

Partnering with product, engineering, security, operations, and enterprise architecture leaders, you will evaluate emerging technologies, guide proofs of concept, and ensure modern product designs meet architecture, security, governance, and operational standards across public cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

The successful candidate will bring deep AWS architecture expertise, strong DevOps and SDLC automation experience, and the ability to apply agentic AI responsibly to improve scalability, delivery speed, resiliency, and long-term maintainability.

Responsibilities

  • Define enterprise architecture blueprints for secure, scalable AWS environments optimized for autonomous AI agent orchestration
  • Embed AI-driven automation directly into the DevOps SDLC to accelerate software delivery, testing, and security scanning
  • Align C-suite technology strategy with implementation teams, defining governance, security, and compliance frameworks for AI workflows
  • Define and communicate the architectural vision and strategy for healthcare SaaS products, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology direction and product roadmap priorities
  • Design and implement cloud-native SaaS architectures that perform at scale, with emphasis on elasticity, availability, resiliency, and secure integration across infrastructure, services, and applications
  • Maintain a holistic product technology scorecard, including the technical roadmap, technical debt inventory, product security alignment, architecture standards, and operational reference model compliance
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, promoting best practices in software design, development, operational optimization, and continuous learning
  • Champion elastic, serverless, and microservice architecture patterns that support highly scalable and resilient SaaS products aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud best practices
  • Ensure solutions adhere to applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, architecture governance expectations, and data security and privacy obligations
  • Produce and shepherd architecture artifacts, designs, and decision records through the architecture governance process
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, clients, product management, engineering, technical platform architects, security, and operations to translate business needs into actionable product architecture designs
  • Drive adoption of emerging technologies and methodologies, including AI/ML, automation, microservices, and serverless architectures, incorporating relevant trends into the architectural roadmap

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Distinguished engineer/architect with deep technical credibility and enterprise-level architecture leadership capability
  • Deep, hands-on strategic knowledge of modern SDLC automation and Agentic AI platform design
  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services, cloud architecture principles, cost optimization strategies, and secure cloud-native implementation patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in cloud-native serverless application design and development, microservices architecture, event-driven design patterns, and multi-region, multi-tenant SaaS models
  • Ability to apply scalability, high availability, data retention, disaster recovery, resiliency, monitoring, observability, and security best practices across enterprise SaaS environments
  • Working knowledge of healthcare technology compliance frameworks and regulations, including HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, data privacy, and cloud identity and access models
  • Strong architecture governance capability, including the ability to define standards, produce architecture artifacts, document decisions, and guide solutions through governance review
  • Advanced critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to listen, synthesize complex technical and business inputs, analyze data, and make sound recommendations
  • Strong executive communication, interpersonal influence, and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to lead technical discussions, align technical and non-technical audiences, and drive innovation

Experience

  • 10 years experience in application or solution architecture
  • 8 years experience in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, cloud-native application design and deployment
  • 5 year proven track record of successfully designing, deploying, and managing large-scale, complex serverless SaaS solutions on public cloud, preferably AWS
  • 5 years experience with modern development practices such as CI/CD, infrastructure as code (IaC), and DevOps

Preferred Experience

  • 5 years experience as an architect in a commercial SaaS environment
  • 5 years experience operating within an architecture governance framework

Required Training, Certification and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent experience
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional

Preferred Training, Certification and Education

  • Master’s degree
  • Other relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, ITIL, Cloud Security) are a plus

Working Conditions:

  • Home Office/Remote
  • Occasional overnight travel (up to 10%) by land and/or air
  • Must be able to use equipment at workstation for up to 8 hours daily

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits

Financial Health Benefits

  • 401K Plan with employer matching contributions

  • Bonus and Recognition programs

  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

  • E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

Job Description

A bit about this role:

This position represents an amazing opportunity for an Advanced Practice Provider (NP/PA) to help build Devoted Medical’s Transitions of Care (TOC) Program. The TOC program provides virtual care in the 30 day window after a patient is discharged from the acute setting (hospital or skilled nursing facility). The clinical team is highly interdisciplinary and composed of coordinators, guides, nurse case managers, nurse practitioners, and a medical director. The program’s goal is to prevent readmissions by providing exceptional, comprehensive wrap-around care in the post-discharge period.

The TOC APP will provide virtual clinical care for a wide range of diseases and across a wide spectrum of acuity. This position will require the ability to conduct a comprehensive post-discharge medical assessment, develop individualized care plans, and provide disease-specific clinical education regarding management and red flags. The TOC APP must also be comfortable diagnosing, managing, and monitoring decompensating patients with common readmission conditions such as heart failure, COPD, diabetes, hypertension, pneumonia, cellulitis, and urinary tract infections.

The role will require significant interdisciplinary collaboration with nurse case managers, clinical guides, and clinical coordinators, all aimed at providing the best post-discharge care for patients possible. The TOC APP will also help enhance the team culture of the program by fostering a safe environment for team communication and patient escalations.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Perform initial TOC visits. These visits include comprehensive post-discharge assessment of patients’ medical conditions, medications, functional status, and psychosocial needs. Additional requirements include completing a post-discharge medication reconciliation, placing appropriate orders (prescriptions, labs, imaging, referrals, home health, DME), providing appropriate disease education, communicating contingency plans for worsening symptoms, and comprehensively assessing a patient’s medical conditions.

  • Perform acute symptom TOC / virtual urgent care visits. These are visits focused on addressing a patient’s acute need or new symptom. During these visits, NPs will be required to diagnose and manage the patient, and ensure they receive the appropriate level of care.

  • Participate in interdisciplinary TOC rounds. This is an interdisciplinary meeting to discuss patients who are at highest risk of readmission.

  • Work in an interdisciplinary fashion with RNs, LPNs, and clinical coordinators.

  • Assist with the clinical education of the overall team.

  • Enhance team culture by facilitating safe, open communication across team roles

  • Utilize our home grown electronic health information system for visits while also providing feedback on how to improve the interface.

  • Regularly participate in quality improvement projects and pilots.

  • As our healthcare environment and service needs continue to evolve, this role may expand to include additional responsibilities such as supporting new clinical/organizational programs/initiatives and integrating innovative virtual care practices.

  • We seek candidates who are adaptable, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic setting where change is constant. Flexibility in scope of practice and willingness to embrace new challenges are essential for success and professional growth in this role.

Required skills and experience:

  • At least 3 years of experience in hospital, post-hospital setting, or primary care setting, with clear understanding of common hospital discharge diagnoses, post-discharge needs, and the medical management required to avoid readmissions.

  • Ability to work full-time, five-8 hour days/week (Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM; CST/MST/PST preferred), including one weekend shift per month.

  • Strong team player, with a desire to work in an interdisciplinary team to provide the best care to patients.

  • Role licensure and good standing is required in existing or future Devoted states. Able and willing to get licensed in required states within 90 days of hire.

  • RN and APRN licenses are active and in good standing or Physician Assistant licenses are active and in good standing.

  • Active BLS certification at time of hire and must maintain while employed at Devoted Medical.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience in internal medicine, urgent care, emergency room, hospital medicine, post-acute medicine, and/or geriatrics.

  • Experience performing visits over telehealth video platforms.
    Experience in managing post-transitions patients and being able to identify the need for immediate interventions.

  • Experience in managing acute/chronic disease exacerbations including CHF exacerbations, diabetic emergencies, COPD exacerbations and hypertensive emergencies.

Salary range: $121,000 - $171,720 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

The Opportunity

The Director of IT Cybersecurity will own and manage Ensemble's cybersecurity platforms, ensuring they are deployed, configured, and operated effectively to protect the organization. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will manage a team of security engineers and analysts responsible for the day-to-day operation of cybersecurity platforms, while also directly contributing to platform administration and technical problem-solving. The Director of IT Cybersecurity will develop a keen understanding of Ensemble's unique business requirements to identify and reduce enterprise risk, and will report to the Deputy CISO.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns the end-to-end lifecycle of Ensemble's cybersecurity platforms (e.g., SIEM, EDR/XDR, IAM, vulnerability management, firewalls and network security tools), including deployment, configuration, tuning, upgrades, and end-of-life planning.
  • Ensures cybersecurity platforms are properly integrated, licensed, and performing to established service levels.
  • Evaluates and recommends new security platforms and tools as business needs and the threat landscape evolve.
  • Manages vendor relationships and contracts for cybersecurity tooling.
  • Manages the budget for cybersecurity platforms and tooling, including forecasting and cost optimization.
  • Provides hands-on leadership to a team of security engineers and analysts, balancing direct platform work with delegation, setting priorities, reviewing work, and coaching for technical growth.
  • Establishes change control and configuration management practices for cybersecurity platforms to ensure changes are tracked, tested, and approved before deployment.
  • Partners with security Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) - e.g., incident response, threat intel, compliance - to ensure platforms are configured to meet their operational needs.
  • Ensures platforms meet required security standards by providing control assurance evidence and validation to demonstrate ongoing effectiveness.
  • Partners with other IT teams whose systems and applications are protected by Ensemble's cybersecurity platforms.
  • Develops and tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for platform health, uptime, and operational success.
  • Reports on platform status, risks, and roadmap to the Deputy CISO, and participates in relevant status meetings.

Job Competencies

Leadership Decision Making - Makes day-to-day leadership decisions by securing and comparing information from multiple sources to identify issues; commits to an action after weighing alternative solutions against important criteria; effectively communicates decisions to the appropriate people and teams and holds them accountable. Drives results.

Coaching & Building Talent - Achieves results through other leaders by empowering them and providing feedback, instruction and development (coaching the coach) to develop their own associates; plans and supports the growth of individual skills and abilities in preparation for their next role (building bench); focuses on retention of high performers.

Delegation - Successfully shares authority and responsibilities with others to move decision making and accountability downward through the organization while accomplishing strategic priorities; maintains personal ownership of outcomes without excessive involvement.

Leading Teams - Inspires and sustains team unity and engagement by developing, motivating, and guiding the team to achieve results together through productive relationships and work.

Executive Communication - Clearly and succinctly conveys information and ideas; communicates in a focused and compelling way that captures and holds others' attention (appropriate, impactful, and clear).

Program/Project Management - Demonstrates high accountability and responsibility for projects and programs from inception through completion/implementation; manages budget and resource planning and awareness to ensure maximized output, reduced waste and exceptional results.

Employment Qualifications

  • CISSP, CompTIA SecurityX, GIAC (GSEC/GCIA/GMON), or equivalent platform/technical certification; vendor-specific certifications (e.g., SIEM, EDR, or IAM platform certs) a plus.
  • 5-7 years or relative experience
  • 2-3 years, or more, of true leadership experience
  • Bachelors Degree in Information Systems or Equivalent Experience
  • Practical experience building threat-based cybersecurity programs and designing and implementing security controls and compliance programs.
  • Hands-on experience administering and managing cybersecurity platforms such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, IAM, vulnerability management, or network security tools, with experience leading engineering or operations teams responsible for these platforms.
  • Self-motivated and willing to take on challenges while adapting to an ever-changing operational environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent collaboration skills - must be eager to work as part of a cohesive team and work as a partner to other teams within Ensemble, locally and globally.
  • Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to gather relevant data and information, actively listen, dialogue freely, verbalize ideas effectively, negotiate tense situations successfully, and manage and resolve conflict.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated initiative, customer orientation and teamwork competencies.
  • Adaptability, flexibility and ability to work as part of a team across functional boundaries or in an individual capacity.
  • This role pays between $141,300- 223,200 based on experience
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Additional requirements

About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

  • Fight for the Customer
  • Execute Ruthlessly
  • Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly
  • Collaborate Selflessly
  • Practice Calculated Risk-Taking
  • Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Chief Medical/Longevity Officer to join our leadership team. In this role, you will serve as the clinical and scientific voice of Hone—shaping our longevity medicine strategy, elevating our patient care model, and ensuring that everything we do is grounded in the best available evidence. You will partner cross-functionally with our internal teams to translate cutting-edge longevity science into real outcomes for our patients. This is a unique opportunity to define a category, build something that hasn’t been done before, and leave a genuine mark on how Americans age.

Primary Responsibilities

Key responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to) the following:

Clinical & Scientific Leadership
  • Define and own Hone’s longevity medicine strategy, including our clinical protocols, therapeutic frameworks, and evidence standards
  • Serve as the primary scientific voice for Hone’s approach to hormone optimization, metabolic health, gut health, immunity, cardiac care, and other longevity-focused therapeutic areas
  • Stay at the forefront of longevity science and translate emerging research into actionable clinical insights and product improvements
  • Oversee the development and continuous improvement of clinical protocols in partnership with Hone-affiliated medical practices

About Us

Fenix24 is an industry-leading cyber disaster recovery and restoration company. Battling threat actors as The World’s First Civilian Cybersecurity Force, Fenix24 delivers cybersecurity services through its four battalions: Fenix24 for ransomware recovery and restoration; Athena7 for IT security assessments, strategy and planning; Grypho5 for ongoing security-based management; and Argos99 for expert insights into data, assets and infrastructure. Under its Securitas Summa program, Fenix24 ensures organizations are prepared to effectively resist and rapidly recover from a cyberattack, offering a combination of managed data and infrastructure protection, real-time threat intelligence, and ongoing hardening and breach resistance.

About This Position

The Principal Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the expert individual contributor within the Customer Success organization, accountable for the success of our most strategic and complex customer relationships. This role drives long-term customer value, retention, and growth through deep alignment with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Beyond owning a portfolio of high-value accounts, the Principal CSM solves the most complex customer scenarios, removes systemic blockers, and turns customer experience into improvements for Customer Success programs and plays. Success is measured by the ability to protect and grow the organization's most important customer relationships, drive resolution of complex challenges, and build repeatable approaches that improve outcomes across Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage a portfolio of the organization's most strategic and complex accounts, driving long-term strategy focused on value realization, retention, and expansion

  • Align cross-functionally across Sales, Service Delivery, Product, Support, and Executive teams to remove blockers and drive outcomes
  • Act as the escalation authority for the most complex customer situations, spanning technical, commercial, and operational domains
  • Translate lessons learned from complex engagements into improved Customer Success plays, programs, and best practices
  • Provide strategic guidance for critical account planning, at-risk accounts, and renewal/expansion strategy
  • Partner with the Principal TAM as a peer advisor, and with Sales and Engineering on long-term growth planning
  • Deliver executive business reviews and value-based reporting; track key metrics and KPIs across adoption, expansion, and account health

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 10+ years in Customer Success, account management, or a related customer-facing role, with demonstrated success managing complex enterprise relationships
  • Strong executive presence and credibility at the C-suite level
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority
  • Deep experience developing and executing long-term account strategy, with advanced problem-solving skills in ambiguous environments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including at the executive level
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills
  • Solid understanding of recurring revenue models, customer growth strategy, and service level/contract alignment
  • Experience in a service delivery or managed services environment, with a strong grasp of IT infrastructure and security concepts
  • Practical InfoSec experience and real-world application of cybersecurity principles for customers
